macros.reason: its row is the group's 8-lane vector (256 bits) and its capacity splits the group's 4,096 words into exactly two banks (row parity), so any 8 consecutive local words -- an unaligned stride-1 vector of the group's 8 lanes -- fall in one row of each bank.  No geometry built from the index's macros is conflict-free on the measured ops (word interleaving would need 32-bit banks, which the index lacks); on the full-shape L0 program 256x256 and 128x256 violate on the same vectors, and 256x256 is 9% smaller and has half the macros (see comparison)

read_rule.statement: per cycle, per group, per read class: the local words asked for lie in at most one row of each bank (at most two 8-word rows of opposite parity); a broadcast counts once
read_rule.holds_for: any stride-1 run of <= 9 consecutive local words; any broadcast; row-aligned packed rows

vehicle.source: the reduced V4.1 vehicle's one-token program (hdc_program_v41.Builder), every stream op laid out at N = 1,024 / M = 256 by rtl_hdc_v41x_vec_campaign.layout; gathered operands use the index values the ISA simulator holds before the op

full_shape_l0.source: results/rtl/hdc_v41x_fullshape_program_bind_rope_hbm.json instruction trace (113 instructions), stream ops resolved with the core's FULL_SHAPE DYN bank at each position; gathered operand streams (a_ind) are counted but their index values are unknown here

writes.macro_write_port: one masked 256-bit row write per bank per cycle (ot_sram_1r1w: w_ce/w_addr/wd/w_mask); every write goes to all R replicas of its bank

clients.per_group_per_cycle: <= 8 words, <= 1 row per bank under the read rule applied to the write stream
1 word (consecutive r_so = 1 results); <= 128 in the worst case

clients.note: exclusive with every engine: the core drains all units before a collective (ot_hdc_core_v41x S_ISSUE, d_unit 6)

writes.chosen: fixed-priority arbitration E > R > S > C per bank into a per-bank write buffer (4 rows, merged by row) with read forwarding on every replica read port
writes.never_loses_a_write: a write enters the buffer the cycle it arrives; the buffer drains one row a cycle through the macro port when E does not use it; every read port compares its row with the buffer and takes the newest buffered words, so a buffered write is 'written' (protocol of ot_hdc_v41x_vec) the cycle after it arrives; a full buffer holds the collective tree (valid/ready) and raises a sticky fault for the fixed-timing classes (never a silent drop)
writes.cost_cycles: 0 on every read (forwarding) while the buffer does not fill; the depth is sized from the RTL monitor's measured per-bank occupancy (results/rtl/w11_vm_dist_gate.json)
writes.alternative_rejected: dedicated write banks (a live-value table with one replica set per write class) multiply the 1536 macros by the 3 fixed-timing classes (32.7 mm2)

x_gather.client: matvec x-broadcast read (ME / QE / HE / XU x operands; model vm_read_elems)
x_gather.path: farthest group -> VM port (gather), request broadcast outward on the same run

coll_write.client: collective DMA write from HUB_COLLECTIVE (4 x 512-bit words)
coll_write.path: HUB_COLLECTIVE centre -> VM port -> farthest group

su_results.path: reducer root at the block centre -> farthest group (a broadcast bus; each group takes the slots whose address it owns)

footprint.basis: macros at their area; lane and VM logic at 50% utilisation; 16 x 8 group tiles spanning HUB_SU_VECTOR's width, centred on the VM port's y

variant_lanes_at_cell_area.note: the model's lane-area basis (11.96 mm2 of cells, no utilisation) plus the VM macros

footprint.excludes: the lane <-> group network for non-local SU accesses (see discrepancies)

discrepancies.item: SU operand reads and element writes are not lane-group-local
discrepancies.model: VM_DIST prices 0 stages for SU reads / element writes ('element writes are local'); the stream_unit ledger has no network between lanes and banks
discrepancies.measured: 2,306,117 of 2,603,621 SU element accesses of the vehicle at N = 1,024 (88.6%) name an element in another group (base not a multiple of 128, packed rows, pair / half streams, broadcasts)
discrepancies.consequence: a group-to-lane network per read class (rotation + broadcast at least) and a lane-to-group network for element writes; its stages add to the SU fetch / write depth

discrepancies.item: tree distances assume a 3,458 um lane square at 100% utilisation without the VM macros
discrepancies.model: x gather / scatter 5,187 um, collective 9,103 um, results 3,458 um
discrepancies.consequence: stages x 10 (model 6), scatter 10 (6), collective 15 (11), SU results 7 (4); with the lanes at their cell area (the model's basis) 9 / 9 / 14 / 6

discrepancies.measured: 1536 x ot_sram_1r1w_256x256_m2_r2c2 = 10.89 mm2 (R = 6 read replicas x 2 banks x 128 groups)

discrepancies.item: non-SU readers outside the model's x-gather client list
discrepancies.model: x gather = the matvec x operand (64 elements/cycle)
discrepancies.measured: the core also reads the VM through HE x (8 ports), QE 32-element reads and expert index, XU element / 32-element reads, the select's 4 x 16 score reads, the QE streamer's expert id, and the die's word ports A / B (package controller, collective source); all of them share the x-gather tree and its replica (class X)
